## 2. What can close a gap once the device is soldered

- Strip compliance: 0.01 mm (EST: no catalogue compression data for SIL PAD 2000).
- Lead elastic translation at 200 MPa (EST): 0.0095 mm at the stiffest corner; translation stiffness up to 11924 N/mm, so the clamp cannot move a soldered device.
- **Budget 0.0195 mm.** Without shims the spread is 0.270-2.100 mm: closes? U False, R False. **The strip + clamp alone does not close every tab.**
- With a per-device shim selected in 0.025 mm steps the residual is <= 0.0125 mm: closes = **True**.

## 3. Lean

- Bow/twist 0.75 % of the 346.7 mm diagonal = 2.60 mm: common lean up to 0.0547 rad (3.14 deg; the floating sink tilts to it), differential across the 58.1 mm row 0.00274 rad.
- Leads' elastic lean 0.0148 rad (0.85 deg). **Inspection limit per device, relative to the row mean: 0.0112 rad (0.64 deg)**, i.e. a gap difference <= 0.179 mm between the gauge heights z 6.50 and 22.55.
- The limit is the smaller of the elastic lean and the lean whose straightening moment (14729 N mm/rad, lever 15.0 mm, EST pivot at the board) still leaves a device set at the 60 N target >= 45 N on its strip: 0.0139 rad. At that lean the clamp spends 13.7 N and the strip sees >= 45.0 N (bar deflection included).

## 4. Spring force at a shimmed device, per FR-4 pad option

Zero-shim device: 68.4-85.4 N (bench_thermal.py). A shim s moves the package front s closer to the bar: +18.51 N/mm.

| pad | shim range mm (60-102 N, off solid) | force at the range start N |
|---|---|---|
| FR-4 1.6 | 0.0-0.897 | 68.4-85.4 |
| FR-4 0.8 | 0.596-1.467 | 60.0-85.9 |
| no pad | 1.306-2.337 | 60.0-82.9 |

The options cover 0-2.337 mm; worst spread 2.100 mm: covered = **True**. The 'no pad' option puts the spring end on the package front (the FR-4 pad is credited for nothing; insulation.md).

## 5. Sink, bar and BR1 positions

- Sink face y 0.531 .. 2.631 (nominal 1.581): the floating sink settles on the most-proud tab; bracket slots must give at least +/- 1.05 mm in y and +/- 3.1 deg of tilt.
- Bar back face to the C38-C41 courtyard: >= 1.249 mm at the deepest sink position.
- BR1 (fitted later by the owner, seated on the strip by its screw): lead play +/- 0.124..0.565 mm. Shim behind the strip at BR1 -0.610 .. 1.490 mm. A positive value is selected at the BR1 dry fit; a negative one is taken by the lead play and, beyond it, by leaning BR1 back 0.0362 rad about its holes before soldering (the 1.6 mm board allows 0.154 rad): fits = **True**.
- Unseated body float allowed by the strip-top creepage: 2.26 mm (acceptance set at 1.0 mm).
